newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge, Nortel up on sector rise.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge, Nortel up on sector rise.

text.p: Shares in high-tech companies Newbridge Networks Corp and Northern Telecom Ltd rose in fairly active trading on Monday, galvanized by a revival of interest in U.S. networking and technology shares.
Nortel shares were up 2.40 at 92.65 on the Toronto Stock Exchange and 1-7/8 at 66-7/8 in New York. Newbridge advanced 1.25 to 41.70 on the TSE and 1-1/8 to 30-1/8 on the NYSE.
Newbridge networking rival Cisco Systems Inc jumped 3-5/8 to 54-1/2 in heavy volume.
"There's a pretty healthy rebound in the networking sector," said Robert MacLellan, an industry analyst at New York-based Dillon Read.
He said Newbridge may also be getting a boost from speculation about further mergers in the networking sector given Ascend Communications Inc's planned merger with Cascade Communications Corp.
"Newbridge has been mentioned as a possible takeover candidate but I give it very little credibility...I would say the chances are about nil," MacLellan said.
He said the company's substantial market capitalization and the fact that it is held 1/4 by Chairman and Chief Executive Terry Matthews make a takeover bid highly unlikely.
UBS Securities analyst Nikos Theodosopoulos earlier today issued a report which discussed his meeting with management.

"Based on a recent visit at Newbridge headquarters, we believe the company remains on track to meet our estimates of C$456 million in revenues and US$0.29 in EPS (earnings per share) for this current third quarter which ends in April," the report said.
In the report, Theodosopoulos said he is maintaining his buy rating with a US$42 price target.
